"""Independent read-only CI docs classification, source-pinned path denominator."""
import dataclasses
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

base = 'c40d4acae1ce58b597267255026d9356565828fd'
root = Path('/workspace/e02-F-base-control')
product = root / 'policy-engine'
sys.path[:0] = [str(product), str(product/'src')]
from tools.quality.validation.check_docs_gate import build_gate_plan

out_dir = Path('/workspace/e02-F-receipts')
jobs = json.loads((out_dir/'F-docs-ci-jobs.json').read_text())
leases = {18: 'docs/reference/foundry/causal-statistical-validity.md',
          19: 'docs/reference/foundry/causal-engine-architecture.md'}
rows = []
for job in jobs:
    pr = job['pr']
    head = job['snapshot_head']
    path = out_dir/f'F-docs-pr{pr}-native-job-log.txt'
    log = path.read_text()
    merge = re.search(r'HEAD is now at [a-f0-9]+ Merge [a-f0-9]+ into [a-f0-9]+', log)
    exact_merge = re.findall(r"/usr/bin/git log -1 --format='%H'\n[^\n]*?([a-f0-9]{40})", log)
    if not exact_merge:
        # A checkout step renders this exact Git command and the next timestamped line.
        exact_merge = re.findall(r'git log -1 --format=%H\n[^\n]*?([a-f0-9]{40})', log)
    changed = subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',base,head],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines()
    assert all(p.startswith('policy-engine/') for p in changed)
    relative = [p.removeprefix('policy-engine/') for p in changed]
    plan = build_gate_plan(relative)
    row = dict(pr=pr, run_id=job['run_id'], job_id=job['job_id'],
               job_url=job['url'], event_head_sha=head, source_base_sha=base,
               checkout_merge_sha={15:'8280a4aa6e028af0dd74d2f987ce6fc6e498b877',
                                   18:'2a8cc6bb6776f74886c2bdb88dbbdb76c93a9225',
                                   19:'674146c9053dc61b9db08bd88d16a76f7cdf51eb',
                                   20:'7f0c1573281a9379c61b256ae5a714ea127591dd'}[pr],
               checkout_merge_log_line=merge.group() if merge else None,
               full_changed_paths=changed, changed_path_count=len(changed),
               actual_before_plan=dataclasses.asdict(plan),
               failed_step='Run path-aware docs drift gate',
               job_conclusion=job['conclusion'],
               failed_child_command=['uv','run','polisyos-tools','validation','check-docs-freshness-baseline'],
               source_sha_log_match=(head in log and base in log),
               complete_native_log=dict(path=str(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size,
                                        lines=len(log.splitlines()),sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()),
               native_ci_environment=dict(python='3.14.7',docs_profile_setup='success'),
               unreached_steps=[s['name'] for s in job['steps'] if s['conclusion']=='skipped'])
    if pr in leases:
        prospective = build_gate_plan(relative+[leases[pr]])
        row['concrete_own_regression'] = 'missing required Foundry canonical documentation companion'
        row['approved_unique_doc_path'] = 'policy-engine/'+leases[pr]
        row['prospective_path_predicate_only'] = dataclasses.asdict(prospective)
        row['prospective_is_actual_docs_validation'] = False
    else:
        row['concrete_own_regression'] = None
    rows.append(row)

summary = dict(schema='e02.F.docs-ci-read-only.v1', source_base_sha=base,
  scope='Actual completed Docs quality jobs PR15/18/19/20; full changed-path sets and bounded documentation coverage planning',
  rows=rows,
  rule_source=dict(path='policy-engine/tools/quality/validation/check_docs_gate.py',
                   source_sha=base, accepted_foundry_evidence=['docs/reference/foundry/**','docs/benchmarks/**','docs/explanation/causal-engine.md','docs/reference/documentation-inventory.md'],
                   behavior='All docs/** companion JSON/TXT activate docs_accuracy and strict_docs_build. Actual command loop fails fast at freshness; own path findings remain printed.'),
  common_freshness_failure=dict(exit_code=1, expired='2026-06-30', expected_count=0, observed_count=10,
    expected_sha256='a3030ecf013ab9e3e7ffec891b2743e7dac6f2892361fad35f63774f7e4fe7a2',
    observed_sha256='459cc4ff53c6dcb5cb8444e1bc22c715583f3a69411870176a6bf06bafcdb6be',
    provenance_class='FAILED, same base replay observed; P41 attribution not yet established without complete measured input denominator',
    no_exception_or_baseline_changes=True),
  native_base_replay=json.loads((out_dir/'F-docs-base-freshness-native-replay.json').read_text()),
  boundaries=['Whole Docs quality job remains failure; skipped strict build/lifecycle/generator/docstring checks are not PASS.',
              'New own path-rule failures in PR18/19 prevent classifying the whole docs gate as inherited.',
              'Path planning measures companion presence; substantive docs and frozen after/drop controls still require independent review.'])
target=out_dir/'F-docs-ci-semantic-summary.json'
target.write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(summary_path=str(target),bytes=target.stat().st_size,
                    sha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                    rows=[dict(pr=r['pr'],changed_paths=r['changed_path_count'],
                               own_rule_ids=[f['rule_id'] for f in r['actual_before_plan']['findings']],
                               log_sha256=r['complete_native_log']['sha256']) for r in rows]),indent=2))
